decisions.reason: Freshly recovered complete Hong/Benet-Martinez/Chiu/Morris2003 original independently establishes two empirical applicability/salience studies, explicitly described as a boundary condition untested in earlier cultural-prime studies. Current experiments4–6 expressly use the2003 high-salience display to retest that conditional priming finding. Shipped2542 Hong/Chiu/Kung1997 is the earlier generic activation chapter, not this separately identified conditional-finding study. Current printed reference DOI10.1177/0022022103034004005 matches authoritative title/authors/pages; the original front-page alternate printed DOI is retained as a discrepancy, not asserted as an alias.
